method: Original ELF parsing, relocation resolution and instruction inspection, no target execution or emulation. Whole enclosing decode is structural only; manually inspected semantics limited to stated windows.
title: Frame/header/partial-read/LZ4 handoff
notes: Five header bytes, first four big-endian length and fifth flag. Exact-read helper loops while remaining decreases; no progress after a ready successful read produces early EOF. Pending preserves ReadBuf state.
Wire length <= configured max passes; flag exactly1 selects transform, all other flags raw. Chunks are min(remaining,4000000), completed chunks alone advance outer consumed count.

Transform at2b79ace through relative relocation64e7790 to477f8c0 receives payload pointer, wire length, same max. Error and success paths both release owned wire storage; raw path transfers its descriptor.

Owned harness must not promise native reactor/timeout scheduling or stream recovery after a terminal error. Native completed futures are not reusable. Lower recv updates filled/initialized only on success; helper/reactor effects remain outside selected harness.
